finalText:
The build is green now. Two real bugs from the bump, past all the deprecation noise.

`options.js` still read `options.retries`. The new bundler renamed that field to `retryCount`, so it was crashing on `undefined`. Fixed to read the new name.

`retryPolicy.js` threw when a flag was `undefined`. The old config loader used to send `false` for an unset flag, the new one leaves it `undefined`, and the strict check didn't allow for that. Now it just treats anything that isn't exactly `true` as off.

Build finishes in 44.9s with 8 warnings, 0 errors, exit code 0. The 8 remaining warnings are deprecation notices, safe to leave for now.
